get_hook_name: get the human-readable hook name from a numeric hook ID using the HOOK_MAP lookup
get_hashes_raw: compute the raw SHA-1 hash of a file by reading its binary contents
get_hashes_nocr: compute a CRLF-normalized SHA-1 hash of a file for consistent comparison across platforms
review_HOOK_MAP: review the HOOK_MAP dictionary that maps hook objects from the hooks module to their string names
refactor_get_hashes: refactor get_hashes to support additional hash algorithms beyond SHA-1 for file integrity checks
